skill.description: Convert video or audio into colored ASCII MP4 or GIF output.

memory.responsibility: Retain video or audio source plus decisions, observations, and verification evidence needed to resume safely.

planning.responsibility: Transform frame and beat sampler into the ordered, bounded stages defined by this skill.

action.responsibility: Advance the workflow through color glyph renderer while preserving stop conditions and user authority.

capability.responsibility: Expose only the production and rendering capabilities needed for the requested artifact and format.

stages: Choose frame rate width and glyph palette
Render each frame as colored characters
Encode MP4 or GIF with FFmpeg
Inspect motion readability and file size

maturity.claim_boundary: This repository validates and plans the harness contract; it does not claim live service execution or benchmark gains without a connected adapter and measured evidence.
